description: Parameters of exemplar retrieval for phrase-only L2 -> L1 decode (src/semantic/l2_retrieval.py; docs/plans/l2_knowledge_base_retrieval.md section 6). First version: target cost only, no join cost / Viterbi yet. Initial values, not fitted.

transform.note: a member whose exemplar plateau is below min_plateau (in its channel's units) is shifted, not scaled: dividing by a near-zero plateau would amplify noise
